--!strict
-- Minden hangolható érték egy helyen. Ide nyúlj először, ha változtatnál valamin.

local Config = {}

-- A lány (NPC) kinézete. Az asset ID-k a Roblox katalógusból (Marketplace) jönnek:
-- a tárgy oldalának URL-jében lévő szám. 0 / "" = nincs beállítva (sima próbababa).
Config.Companion = {
	Name = "Lumi",
	SkinColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 210),
	DressColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 200),
	LegColor = Color3.fromRGB(250, 250, 250),
	HairColor = Color3.fromRGB(236, 240, 255), -- ezüst haj
	AccentColor = Color3.fromRGB(235, 110, 150), -- masni, hajgumi
	BuiltInLook = true, -- dobozokból épített haj, masni és szoknya; false, ha katalógusból öltözteted
	HairAccessory = "", -- pl. "1234567,7654321" (vesszővel több is mehet)
	Face = 0,
	Shirt = 0,
	Pants = 0,
}

-- Mozgás
Config.PlayerWalkSpeed = 14
Config.FollowSpeed = 10 -- amikor kedvesen követ
Config.HuntSpeed = 13 -- amikor üldöz (legyen kicsit lassabb a játékosnál)
Config.FollowDistance = 7 -- ennyire közelít meg követés közben
Config.CatchDistance = 4 -- ennél közelebb elkap

-- Üldözés
Config.HuntGraceTime = 6 -- ennyi mp előnyt kapsz, mielőtt elindul
Config.CalmDuration = 10 -- egy felhúzott zenedoboz ennyi időre megnyugtatja
Config.CalmCooldown = 25 -- ennyi idő múlva húzható fel újra ugyanaz a doboz
Config.CaughtSafeTime = 6 -- elkapás után ennyi ideig nem bánt

Config.FirstPerson = true -- belső nézet (horrorhoz jobb); false = szabad kamera
Config.EndingTime = 14 -- a zárókép hossza, utána újraindul a fejezet

-- Hangok: "rbxassetid://SZÁM" formában. Üresen hagyva egyszerűen nem szól semmi.
-- A Studio Toolbox > Audio fülén találsz ingyenes hangokat.
Config.Sounds = {
	MusicBox = "", -- a zenedoboz dallama (loopolva)
	Ambience = "", -- halk háttérzaj az üldözés alatt
	LightsOut = "", -- amikor lekapcsolnak a fények
	Caught = "", -- amikor elkap
	Pickup = "", -- tárgy felvétele
}

return Config

--!nonstrict
-- A lány (NPC): létrehozás, animáció és mozgás.
-- Négy állapota van:
--   Idle   - áll egy helyben
--   Follow - kedvesen követi a legközelebbi játékost
--   Hunt   - üldözi a legközelebbi játékost, és elkapja, ha odaér
--   Calm   - megnyugodott (zenedoboz), egy ideig áll, aztán újra Hunt

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local PathfindingService = game:GetService("PathfindingService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))

-- A Roblox alap R15 animációi (minden játékban használhatók)
local IDLE_ANIMATION = "rbxassetid://507766388"
local WALK_ANIMATION = "rbxassetid://507777826"

local STEP_INTERVAL = 0.15

local Companion = {}
Companion.__index = Companion

-- Ha a rendes karakter valamiért nem tölthető be, egy egyszerű dobozfigura is megteszi.
local function buildFallbackRig(): Model
	local settings = Config.Companion
	local model = Instance.new("Model")

	local root = Instance.new("Part")
	root.Name = "HumanoidRootPart"
	root.Size = Vector3.new(2, 4, 1.5)
	root.Color = settings.DressColor
	root.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	root.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	root.Parent = model

	local head = Instance.new("Part")
	head.Name = "Head"
	head.Size = Vector3.new(1.6, 1.6, 1.6)
	head.Color = settings.SkinColor
	head.CanCollide = false
	head.Massless = true
	head.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.8, 0)
	head.Parent = model

	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = root
	weld.Part1 = head
	weld.Parent = root

	local humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
	humanoid.RigType = Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15
	humanoid.HipHeight = 1
	humanoid.Parent = model

	model.PrimaryPart = root
	return model
end

-- Egy kis doboz hozzáhegesztve a karakter egyik testrészéhez (haj, masni, szoknya).
local function attach(model: Model, base: BasePart, name: string, size: Vector3, offset: Vector3, color: Color3)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.Massless = true
	part.CFrame = base.CFrame * CFrame.new(offset)
	part.Parent = model

	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = base
	weld.Part1 = part
	weld.Parent = part
end

-- Beépített kinézet: ezüst haj két copffal, masni és szoknya, katalógus nélkül.
-- A karakter -Z irányba néz, tehát a +Z a háta.
local function decorate(model: Model)
	local settings = Config.Companion
	local hair = settings.HairColor
	local accent = settings.AccentColor

	local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if head and head:IsA("BasePart") then
		local s = head.Size
		attach(model, head, "HairTop", Vector3.new(s.X + 0.3, 0.4, s.Z + 0.3), Vector3.new(0, s.Y / 2 + 0.05, 0), hair)
		attach(model, head, "HairBack", Vector3.new(s.X + 0.3, s.Y + 1.4, 0.3), Vector3.new(0, -0.55, s.Z / 2 + 0.1), hair)
		-- A frufru csak a homlok tetejét takarja, hogy a szeme látsszon.
		attach(model, head, "HairBangs", Vector3.new(s.X + 0.3, 0.16, 0.2), Vector3.new(0, s.Y / 2 - 0.07, -(s.Z / 2 + 0.05)), hair)
		for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
			attach(model, head, "HairSide", Vector3.new(0.2, s.Y + 0.3, s.Z * 0.6), Vector3.new(side * (s.X / 2 + 0.05), -0.05, s.Z * 0.25), hair)
			attach(model, head, "HairTie", Vector3.new(0.5, 0.22, 0.5), Vector3.new(side * (s.X / 2 + 0.4), 0.15, 0.2), accent)
			attach(model, head, "Ponytail", Vector3.new(0.45, 2.3, 0.45), Vector3.new(side * (s.X / 2 + 0.4), -1.05, 0.2), hair)
			attach(model, head, "BowLoop", Vector3.new(0.55, 0.4, 0.2), Vector3.new(side * 0.35, s.Y / 2 + 0.45, 0), accent)
		end
		attach(model, head, "BowKnot", Vector3.new(0.25, 0.3, 0.25), Vector3.new(0, s.Y / 2 + 0.42, 0), accent)
	end

	local hips = model:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")
	if hips and hips:IsA("BasePart") then
		local s = hips.Size
		attach(model, hips, "Skirt", Vector3.new(s.X + 0.5, 0.9, s.Z + 0.5), Vector3.new(0, -0.3, 0), settings.DressColor)
		attach(model, hips, "SkirtHem", Vector3.new(s.X + 0.7, 0.2, s.Z + 0.7), Vector3.new(0, -0.8, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
	end

	local chest = model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	if chest and chest:IsA("BasePart") then
		local s = chest.Size
		for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
			attach(model, chest, "RibbonLoop", Vector3.new(0.4, 0.3, 0.12), Vector3.new(side * 0.28, s.Y / 2 - 0.3, -(s.Z / 2 + 0.04)), accent)
		end
		attach(model, chest, "RibbonKnot", Vector3.new(0.18, 0.22, 0.16), Vector3.new(0, s.Y / 2 - 0.3, -(s.Z / 2 + 0.05)), accent)
	end
end

local function buildRig(): Model
	local settings = Config.Companion

	local description = Instance.new("HumanoidDescription")
	description.HeadColor = settings.SkinColor
	description.LeftArmColor = settings.SkinColor
	description.RightArmColor = settings.SkinColor
	description.TorsoColor = settings.DressColor
	description.LeftLegColor = settings.LegColor
	description.RightLegColor = settings.LegColor
	description.HairAccessory = settings.HairAccessory
	description.Face = settings.Face
	description.Shirt = settings.Shirt
	description.Pants = settings.Pants

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(description, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
	end)
	if ok and result and result:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and result:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
		return result
	end

	warn("[Companion] A karakter betöltése nem sikerült, dobozfigurát használok:", result)
	return buildFallbackRig()
end

function Companion.new(startCFrame: CFrame, parent: Instance)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Companion)

	local model = buildRig()
	model.Name = Config.Companion.Name

	local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart
	humanoid.DisplayName = Config.Companion.Name

	-- A gyári "Animate" szkript csak játékos-karakteren fut, itt magunk animálunk.
	local animate = model:FindFirstChild("Animate")
	if animate then
		animate:Destroy()
	end

	if Config.Companion.BuiltInLook then
		decorate(model)
	end

	model:PivotTo(startCFrame)
	model.Parent = parent

	-- A szerver mozgassa, ne egy közeli játékos gépe (különben csalható lenne).
	pcall(function()
		root:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
	end)

	self.model = model
	self.humanoid = humanoid
	self.root = root
	self.mode = "Idle"
	self.calmUntil = 0
	self.alive = true
	self.onCatch = nil :: ((Player) -> ())?
	self.path = PathfindingService:CreatePath({
		AgentRadius = 2,
		AgentHeight = 5,
		AgentCanJump = false,
	})

	self:_setupAnimations()

	task.spawn(function()
		while self.alive do
			self:_step()
			task.wait(STEP_INTERVAL)
		end
	end)

	return self
end

function Companion:_setupAnimations()
	local humanoid: Humanoid = self.humanoid
	local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then
		animator = Instance.new("Animator")
		animator.Parent = humanoid
	end

	local function load(id: string, priority: Enum.AnimationPriority): AnimationTrack?
		local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
		animation.AnimationId = id
		local ok, track = pcall(function()
			return (animator :: Animator):LoadAnimation(animation)
		end)
		if ok and track then
			track.Priority = priority
			track.Looped = true
			return track
		end
		return nil
	end

	local idle = load(IDLE_ANIMATION, Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle)
	local walk = load(WALK_ANIMATION, Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement)
	if idle then
		idle:Play()
	end

	humanoid.Running:Connect(function(speed)
		if not walk then
			return
		end
		if speed > 0.5 then
			if not walk.IsPlaying then
				walk:Play(0.2)
			end
		elseif walk.IsPlaying then
			walk:Stop(0.2)
		end
	end)
end

function Companion:setMode(mode: string)
	self.mode = mode
	if mode == "Follow" then
		self.humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.FollowSpeed
	elseif mode == "Hunt" then
		self.humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.HuntSpeed
	else
		self:_stop()
	end
end

-- Megnyugtatás: ennyi másodpercig áll, utána magától újra üldöz.
function Companion:calm(seconds: number)
	self.calmUntil = os.clock() + seconds
	self:setMode("Calm")
end

function Companion:destroy()
	self.alive = false
	self.model:Destroy()
end

function Companion:_stop()
	self.humanoid:MoveTo(self.root.Position)
end

-- A legközelebbi élő, nem védett játékos.
function Companion:_nearestPlayer(): (Player?, Vector3?, number)
	local bestPlayer, bestPosition, bestDistance = nil, nil, math.huge
	local now = os.clock()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local playerRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local playerHumanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local safeUntil = player:GetAttribute("SafeUntil")
		local isSafe = self.mode == "Hunt" and typeof(safeUntil) == "number" and safeUntil > now
		if playerRoot and playerRoot:IsA("BasePart") and playerHumanoid and playerHumanoid.Health > 0 and not isSafe then
			local distance = (playerRoot.Position - self.root.Position).Magnitude
			if distance < bestDistance then
				bestPlayer, bestPosition, bestDistance = player, playerRoot.Position, distance
			end
		end
	end
	return bestPlayer, bestPosition, bestDistance
end

-- Útvonalkeresés a falak körül: mindig a következő útpont felé indul.
function Companion:_moveToward(goal: Vector3)
	local path: Path = self.path
	local origin = self.root.Position
	local ok = pcall(function()
		path:ComputeAsync(origin, goal)
	end)

	if ok and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
		local waypoints = path:GetWaypoints()
		for i = 2, #waypoints do
			if (waypoints[i].Position - origin).Magnitude > 3 then
				self.humanoid:MoveTo(waypoints[i].Position)
				return
			end
		end
	end

	-- Nincs útvonal (vagy már majdnem ott van): egyenesen a cél felé.
	self.humanoid:MoveTo(goal)
end

function Companion:_step()
	if self.mode == "Idle" then
		return
	end

	if self.mode == "Calm" then
		if os.clock() >= self.calmUntil then
			self:setMode("Hunt")
		end
		return
	end

	local player, position, distance = self:_nearestPlayer()
	if not player or not position then
		self:_stop()
		return
	end

	if self.mode == "Follow" then
		if distance <= Config.FollowDistance then
			self:_stop()
			return
		end
	elseif self.mode == "Hunt" then
		if distance <= Config.CatchDistance then
			if self.onCatch then
				self.onCatch(player)
			end
			return
		end
	end

	self:_moveToward(position)
end

return Companion

scripts.source:
--!nonstrict
-- A "rendező": az első fejezet története fentről lefelé olvasható formában.
-- A Director.run() addig fut, amíg a játékosok ki nem jutnak, utána visszatér,
-- és a Main újraindítja a fejezetet.

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local Config = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Config"))
local Story = require(Shared:WaitForChild("Story"))
local MapBuilder = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MapBuilder"))

local LAMP_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 170)

local Director = {}

type Line = { string }

function Director.run(map: any, companion: any, storyEvent: RemoteEvent)
	local connections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}
	local sounds: { Sound } = {}
	local currentObjective = ""
	local hunting = false

	local function track(connection: RBXScriptConnection)
		table.insert(connections, connection)
	end

	---------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Segédfüggvények
	---------------------------------------------------------------------------

	-- Hang lejátszása; ha nincs beállítva ID a Configban, nem csinál semmit.
	local function playSound(id: string, parent: Instance, looped: boolean?): Sound?
		if id == "" then
			return nil
		end
		local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
		sound.SoundId = id
		sound.Looped = looped == true
		sound.Parent = parent
		sound:Play()
		table.insert(sounds, sound)
		return sound
	end

	-- Egy sor szöveg mindenkinek; megvárja, amíg el lehet olvasni.
	local function say(line: Line)
		local duration = 1.5 + #line[2] * 0.05
		storyEvent:FireAllClients("Dialogue", { speaker = line[1], text = line[2], duration = duration })
		task.wait(duration + 0.3)
	end

	local function sayAll(lines: { Line })
		for _, line in lines do
			say(line)
		end
	end

	-- Megjegyzés, ami nem állítja meg a történetet (egy játékosnak vagy mindenkinek).
	local function remark(line: Line, player: Player?)
		local payload = { speaker = line[1], text = line[2], duration = 3.5 }
		if player then
			storyEvent:FireClient(player, "Dialogue", payload)
		else
			storyEvent:FireAllClients("Dialogue", payload)
		end
	end

	local function setObjective(text: string)
		currentObjective = text
		storyEvent:FireAllClients("Objective", text)
	end

	local function getPrompt(part: Instance): ProximityPrompt
		return part:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt") :: ProximityPrompt
	end

	-- Megvárja, amíg valaki használja a tárgyat, és visszaadja, hogy ki volt az.
	local function waitForUse(part: Instance): Player
		local prompt = getPrompt(part)
		prompt.Enabled = true
		local player = prompt.Triggered:Wait()
		prompt.Enabled = false
		return player
	end

	-- Megvárja, amíg az összes tárgyat összeszedik; közben számolja a célkiírásban.
	local function collectAll(items: { Part }, objectiveFormat: string)
		local total = #items
		local count = 0
		local finished = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
		setObjective(string.format(objectiveFormat, count, total))

		for _, item in items do
			local prompt = getPrompt(item)
			prompt.Enabled = true
			prompt.Triggered:Once(function()
				count += 1
				playSound(Config.Sounds.Pickup, map.folder)
				item:Destroy()
				setObjective(string.format(objectiveFormat, count, total))
				if count >= total then
					finished:Fire()
				end
			end)
		end

		finished.Event:Wait()
		finished:Destroy()
	end

	local function flicker(lamp: any, times: number)
		task.spawn(function()
			for _ = 1, times do
				lamp.light.Enabled = false
				task.wait(0.08 + math.random() * 0.15)
				lamp.light.Enabled = true
				task.wait(0.05 + math.random() * 0.2)
			end
		end)
	end

	-- Ajtó "kinyitása": eltűnik a kilinccsel együtt, és át lehet menni rajta.
	local function openDoor(door: BasePart)
		door.CanCollide = false
		door.Transparency = 1
		for _, child in door:GetDescendants() do
			if child:IsA("BasePart") then
				child.Transparency = 1
			end
		end
	end

	local function closeDoor(door: BasePart)
		door.CanCollide = true
		door.Transparency = 0
		for _, child in door:GetDescendants() do
			if child:IsA("BasePart") then
				child.Transparency = 0
			end
		end
	end

	-- Színhangulat: meleg és telt, amíg kedves; hideg és fakó, amikor üldöz.
	local function colorGrade(saturation: number, contrast: number, tint: Color3)
		local effect = Lighting:FindFirstChild("StoryColor")
		if not effect then
			effect = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
			effect.Name = "StoryColor"
			effect.Parent = Lighting
		end
		effect.Saturation = saturation
		effect.Contrast = contrast
		effect.TintColor = tint
	end

	local function setCozyLighting()
		colorGrade(0.1, 0.05, Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 238))
		Lighting.ClockTime = 0
		Lighting.Brightness = 1
		Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(42, 36, 44)
		Lighting.ExposureCompensation = -0.4
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 45)
		Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
		-- Ha az üldözés után állunk vissza, a lámpák is kapják vissza a meleg fényüket.
		for _, lamp in map.lamps do
			local base = lamp.light:GetAttribute("BaseBrightness")
			if base then
				lamp.light.Brightness = base
			end
			lamp.light.Color = LAMP_COLOR
			lamp.part.Color = LAMP_COLOR
		end
	end

	local function setDarkLighting()
		colorGrade(-0.45, 0.15, Color3.fromRGB(205, 215, 255))
		Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 16)
		Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(5, 5, 10)
		Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		Lighting.FogEnd = 70
		Lighting.ExposureCompensation = -0.7
		for _, lamp in map.lamps do
			if lamp.light:GetAttribute("BaseBrightness") == nil then
				lamp.light:SetAttribute("BaseBrightness", lamp.light.Brightness)
			end
			lamp.light.Brightness = 0.1
			lamp.light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 90)
			lamp.part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 30, 45)
		end
	end

	-- Zseblámpa-szerű fény a játékoson az üldözés alatt.
	local function giveLight(character: Model)
		local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
		if root and not root:FindFirstChild("HuntLight") then
			local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
			light.Name = "HuntLight"
			light.Range = 18
			light.Brightness = 0.7
			light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(230, 235, 255)
			light.Parent = root
		end
	end

	local function setupCharacter(player: Player, character: Model)
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
		if humanoid and humanoid:IsA("Humanoid") then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.PlayerWalkSpeed
		end
		if hunting then
			giveLight(character)
		end
	end

	local function setupPlayer(player: Player)
		player.CameraMode = if Config.FirstPerson then Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson else Enum.CameraMode.Classic
		player:SetAttribute("SafeUntil", 0)
		track(player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
			setupCharacter(player, character)
		end))
		if player.Character then
			setupCharacter(player, player.Character)
		end
		-- Aki később csatlakozik, az is lássa az aktuális célt.
		if currentObjective ~= "" then
			storyEvent:FireClient(player, "Objective", currentObjective)
		end
	end

	---------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Előkészítés
	---------------------------------------------------------------------------

	setCozyLighting()
	workspace:SetAttribute("Hunting", false)

	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		setupPlayer(player)
	end
	track(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(setupPlayer))

	-- Megvárjuk az első játékost és a karakterét.
	while #Players:GetPlayers() == 0 do
		Players.PlayerAdded:Wait()
	end
	local firstPlayer = Players:GetPlayers()[1]
	if firstPlayer and not firstPlayer.Character then
		firstPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	end
	task.wait(2)

	---------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 1. Érkezés
	---------------------------------------------------------------------------

	setObjective(Story.Objectives.Welcome)
	sayAll(Story.Intro)

	-- A raktár ajtaja végig megnyomható; hogy mi történik, az a történet állásától függ.
	local hasStorageKey = false
	local lastStorageRemark = 0
	local storagePrompt = getPrompt(map.storageDoor)
	storagePrompt.Enabled = true
	track(storagePrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		if hasStorageKey then
			storagePrompt.Enabled = false
			openDoor(map.storageDoor)
			remark(Story.StorageOpened)
			setObjective(Story.Objectives.FrontKey)
		elseif os.clock() - lastStorageRemark > 4 then
			lastStorageRemark = os.clock()
			remark(if hunting then Story.StorageLockedHunt else Story.StorageLocked, player)
		end
	end))

	---------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 2. Teázás
	---------------------------------------------------------------------------

	companion:setMode("Follow")
	collectAll(map.cups, Story.Objectives.Cups)
	sayAll(Story.TeaReady)

	setObjective(Story.Objectives.Table)
	waitForUse(map.kitchenTable)
	flicker(map.lamps[3], 4) -- a konyhai lámpa megrebben: az első furcsaság
	sayAll(Story.TeaDone)

	---------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 3. Plüssök
	---------------------------------------------------------------------------

	collectAll(map.plushies, Story.Objectives.Plushies)
	for _, lamp in map.lamps do
		flicker(lamp, 3)
	end
	storyEvent:FireAllClients("Effect", "Glitch")
	sayAll(Story.PlushiesDone)

	---------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 4. A zenedoboz
	---------------------------------------------------------------------------

	setObjective(Story.Objectives.MusicBox)
	waitForUse(map.musicBox)
	local tune = playSound(Config.Sounds.MusicBox, map.musicBox, true)
	sayAll(Story.MusicBoxWound)

	map.note.Transparency = 0
	setObjective(Story.Objectives.Note)
	local reader = waitForUse(map.note)
	storyEvent:FireClient(reader, "Note", Story.Note)
	-- A cetli utána is újraolvasható.
	local notePrompt = getPrompt(map.note)
	notePrompt.Enabled = true
	track(notePrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		storyEvent:FireClient(player, "Note", Story.Note)
	end))
	task.wait(8)

	---------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- 5. Üldözés és szökés
	---------------------------------------------------------------------------

	companion:setMode("Idle")
	if tune then
		tune:Stop()
	end
	say(Story.HuntStart[1])

	hunting = true
	workspace:SetAttribute("Hunting", true) -- a kliens ebből tudja, hogy mutassa a közelségjelzőt
	setDarkLighting()
	playSound(Config.Sounds.LightsOut, map.folder)
	playSound(Config.Sounds.Ambience, map.folder, true)
	storyEvent:FireAllClients("Effect", "Glitch")
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if player.Character then
			giveLight(player.Character)
		end
	end

	say(Story.HuntStart[2])
	say(Story.HuntStart[3])

	local escaped = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
	local hasFrontKey = false

	-- Ha elkap: nem halsz meg, csak "felébredsz" az előszobában.
	companion.onCatch = function(player: Player)
		player:SetAttribute("SafeUntil", os.clock() + Config.CaughtSafeTime)
		playSound(Config.Sounds.Caught, map.folder)
		storyEvent:FireClient(player, "Effect", "Caught")
		companion:calm(3)
		task.delay(0.5, function()
			local character = player.Character
			if character then
				character:PivotTo(map.spawn.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
			end
			remark(Story.Caught, player)
		end)
	end

	-- Kis zenedobozok: megnyugtatják, de utána egy ideig nem húzhatók fel újra.
	for _, calmBox in map.calmBoxes do
		local prompt = getPrompt(calmBox)
		prompt.Enabled = true
		track(prompt.Triggered:Connect(function()
			prompt.Enabled = false
			companion:calm(Config.CalmDuration)
			remark(Story.Calmed)
			local chime = playSound(Config.Sounds.MusicBox, calmBox, false)
			task.delay(Config.CalmDuration, function()
				if chime then
					chime:Stop()
				end
			end)
			task.delay(Config.CalmCooldown, function()
				if hunting then
					prompt.Enabled = true
				end
			end)
		end))
	end

	-- Raktárkulcs a párna alatt
	setObjective(Story.Objectives.StorageKey)
	local pillowPrompt = getPrompt(map.pillow)
	pillowPrompt.Enabled = true
	track(pillowPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function()
		pillowPrompt.Enabled = false
		hasStorageKey = true
		playSound(Config.Sounds.Pickup, map.folder)
		remark(Story.GotStorageKey)
		setObjective(Story.Objectives.Storage)
	end))

	-- Bejárati kulcs a raktárban
	local keyPrompt = getPrompt(map.frontDoorKey)
	keyPrompt.Enabled = true
	track(keyPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function()
		hasFrontKey = true
		playSound(Config.Sounds.Pickup, map.folder)
		map.frontDoorKey:Destroy()
		remark(Story.GotFrontKey)
		setObjective(Story.Objectives.Escape)
	end))

	-- Bejárati ajtó
	local frontPrompt = getPrompt(map.frontDoor)
	frontPrompt.Enabled = true
	track(frontPrompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		if hasFrontKey then
			frontPrompt.Enabled = false
			escaped:Fire()
		else
			remark(Story.FrontDoorLocked, player)
		end
	end))

	companion:calm(Config.HuntGraceTime) -- rövid előny, utána magától üldözni kezd

	-- Üldözés közben időnként megszólal.
	task.spawn(function()
		while hunting do
			task.wait(math.random(10, 16))
			if hunting and companion.mode == "Hunt" then
				remark(Story.Taunts[math.random(#Story.Taunts)])
			end
		end
	end)

	escaped.Event:Wait()
	escaped:Destroy()

	---------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Vége
	---------------------------------------------------------------------------

	hunting = false
	workspace:SetAttribute("Hunting", false)
	companion.onCatch = nil
	companion:setMode("Idle")
	openDoor(map.frontDoor)
	setObjective("")
	sayAll(Story.Escape)

	-- Cliffhanger: a kép elsötétül, és mire visszajön, minden olyan, mint érkezéskor.
	storyEvent:FireAllClients("Effect", "Blackout")
	task.wait(1.2) -- eddigre a képernyő már fekete, a játékos nem látja az átrendezést

	closeDoor(map.frontDoor)
	closeDoor(map.storageDoor)
	setCozyLighting()
	for _, sound in sounds do
		sound:Stop()
	end
	companion.model:PivotTo(map.companionStart)

	-- Mindenki visszakerül az előszobába, és kap egy plüsst a saját nevével a lábtörlőn.
	local players = Players:GetPlayers()
	for index, player in players do
		local offset = (index - (#players + 1) / 2) * 2.4
		local character = player.Character
		if character then
			local light = character:FindFirstChild("HuntLight", true)
			if light then
				light:Destroy()
			end
			character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(map.spawn.Position + Vector3.new(offset, 4, 0)))
		end

		local plush = MapBuilder.plushie(map.folder, Vector3.new(offset, 1, 26.5), Color3.fromRGB(226, 228, 242), -1)
		local tag = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		tag.Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 30)
		tag.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.8, 0)
		tag.MaxDistance = 40
		tag.Parent = plush
		local name = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		name.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		name.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(250, 245, 230)
		name.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 40, 40)
		name.Font = Enum.Font.IndieFlower
		name.TextSize = 22
		name.Text = player.DisplayName
		name.Parent = tag
	end

	task.wait(3.5)
	sayAll(Story.Cliffhanger)
	storyEvent:FireAllClients("Ending", Story.Ending)
	task.wait(Config.EndingTime)

	for _, connection in connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	for _, sound in sounds do
		sound:Destroy()
	end
end

return Director

--!strict
-- Belépési pont a szerveren: felépíti a pályát, létrehozza a lányt, lejátssza
-- a fejezetet, majd mindent töröl és elölről kezdi.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local MapBuilder = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("MapBuilder"))
local Companion = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Companion"))
local Director = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Director"))

-- Ezen az egy csatornán küld a szerver mindent a klienseknek (szöveg, cél, effektek).
local storyEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
storyEvent.Name = "StoryEvent"
storyEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

while true do
	local map = MapBuilder.build()
	local companion = Companion.new(map.companionStart, map.folder)

	-- Mindenki friss karakterrel indul az előszobában.
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		task.spawn(function()
			player:LoadCharacter()
		end)
	end
	storyEvent:FireAllClients("Reset")

	local ok, problem = pcall(Director.run, map, companion, storyEvent)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Main] Hiba a fejezet futása közben:", problem)
		task.wait(5)
	end

	companion:destroy()
	map.folder:Destroy()
end

scripts.source:
--!strict
-- Felépíti a házat egyszerű elemekből. Minden bútor és dísz sima dobozokból áll,
-- hogy asset nélkül is otthonos legyen; később Studióban lecserélhető rendes modellekre.
--
-- Alaprajz felülnézetből (x: nyugat -> kelet, z: észak -> dél), 80 x 60 stud:
--
--   +-----------+-----------+-----------+  z = -30
--   | Hálószoba |  Raktár   | Zeneszoba |
--   +---  ------+--[ajtó]---+------  ---+  z = -5
--   |              Folyosó              |
--   +---  ------+--       --+------  ---+  z = 5
--   |  Nappali  |  Előszoba |   Konyha  |
--   +-----------+-[bejárat]-+-----------+  z = 30
--  x = -40     -12          12          40

local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local MapBuilder = {}

local WALL_HEIGHT = 10
local WALL_THICKNESS = 1
local DOOR_HEIGHT = 8

-- Színpaletta: meleg, pasztell "cuki szoba" hangulat
local WALL_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(214, 180, 178)
local TRIM_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(246, 236, 230)
local CEILING_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(232, 216, 208)
local FLOOR_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(170, 120, 90)
local WOOD_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(150, 105, 80)
local DARK_WOOD_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(105, 70, 55)
local CREAM_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(240, 228, 215)
local PINK_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(235, 150, 175)
local SOFT_PINK_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(250, 200, 215)
local LILAC_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(200, 180, 235)
local MINT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(185, 225, 205)
local SILVER_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 215)
local NIGHT_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(22, 28, 58)
local LAMP_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 170)

export type Lamp = { part: Part, light: PointLight }

export type Map = {
	folder: Folder,
	spawn: SpawnLocation,
	companionStart: CFrame,
	lamps: { Lamp },
	cups: { Part },
	plushies: { Part },
	kitchenTable: Part,
	musicBox: Part,
	note: Part,
	pillow: Part,
	storageDoor: Part,
	frontDoorKey: Part,
	frontDoor: Part,
	calmBoxes: { Part },
}

local function box(parent: Instance, name: string, size: Vector3, position: Vector3, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material?): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Anchored = true
	part.Size = size
	part.Position = position
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

-- Dísz: ugyanaz, mint a box, de nem lehet nekimenni (szőnyeg, kép, függöny...).
local function deco(parent: Instance, name: string, size: Vector3, position: Vector3, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material?): Part
	local part = box(parent, name, size, position, color, material)
	part.CanCollide = false
	return part
end

-- Tengelyirányú fal két pont között (vagy x1 == x2, vagy z1 == z2), szegélyléccel.
local function wall(parent: Instance, x1: number, z1: number, x2: number, z2: number)
	local length = math.abs(x2 - x1) + math.abs(z2 - z1)
	local alongX = z1 == z2
	local center = Vector3.new((x1 + x2) / 2, 0, (z1 + z2) / 2)

	local function slab(name: string, height: number, thickness: number, y: number, color: Color3): Part
		local size = if alongX then Vector3.new(length, height, thickness) else Vector3.new(thickness, height, length)
		return box(parent, name, size, center + Vector3.new(0, y, 0), color)
	end

	slab("Wall", WALL_HEIGHT, WALL_THICKNESS, WALL_HEIGHT / 2, WALL_COLOR)
	slab("Baseboard", 0.6, WALL_THICKNESS + 0.2, 0.3, TRIM_COLOR).CanCollide = false
end

-- Ajtónyílás fölötti falrész, hogy az ajtók ne érjenek plafonig.
local function lintel(parent: Instance, x: number, z: number, width: number)
	local height = WALL_HEIGHT - DOOR_HEIGHT
	box(parent, "Lintel", Vector3.new(width, height, WALL_THICKNESS), Vector3.new(x, DOOR_HEIGHT + height / 2, z), WALL_COLOR)
	deco(parent, "DoorTrim", Vector3.new(width, 0.3, WALL_THICKNESS + 0.2), Vector3.new(x, DOOR_HEIGHT + 0.15, z), TRIM_COLOR)
end

-- Ablak a fal belső oldalán: keret, éjszakai üveg és két függöny.
-- facing: merre néz a szoba felé ("x+" = kelet felé, "z-" = észak felé, stb.)
local function window(parent: Instance, position: Vector3, facing: string, width: number, height: number)
	local alongX = facing == "z+" or facing == "z-"
	local sign = if facing == "x+" or facing == "z+" then 1 else -1
	local out = if alongX then Vector3.new(0, 0, sign) else Vector3.new(sign, 0, 0)
	local side = if alongX then Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) else Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)

	local function panel(name: string, w: number, h: number, depth: number, offset: Vector3, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material?)
		local size = if alongX then Vector3.new(w, h, depth) else Vector3.new(depth, h, w)
		deco(parent, name, size, position + offset, color, material)
	end

	panel("WindowFrame", width + 0.6, height + 0.6, 0.15, out * 0.08, TRIM_COLOR)
	panel("WindowGlass", width, height, 0.15, out * 0.16, NIGHT_COLOR, Enum.Material.Glass)
	panel("WindowBar", 0.2, height, 0.15, out * 0.24, TRIM_COLOR)
	panel("WindowBar", width, 0.2, 0.15, out * 0.24, TRIM_COLOR)
	for _, direction in { -1, 1 } do
		panel("Curtain", 1.2, height + 1.2, 0.25, out * 0.4 + side * direction * (width / 2 + 0.3), SOFT_PINK_COLOR, Enum.Material.Fabric)
	end
end

-- Kép a falon: keret és egy pasztell "festmény".
local function picture(parent: Instance, position: Vector3, facing: string, color: Color3)
	local alongX = facing == "z+" or facing == "z-"
	local sign = if facing == "x+" or facing == "z+" then 1 else -1
	local out = if alongX then Vector3.new(0, 0, sign) else Vector3.new(sign, 0, 0)
	local function panel(name: string, w: number, h: number, offset: Vector3, panelColor: Color3)
		local size = if alongX then Vector3.new(w, h, 0.15) else Vector3.new(0.15, h, w)
		deco(parent, name, size, position + offset, panelColor)
	end
	panel("PictureFrame", 3, 2.4, out * 0.08, DARK_WOOD_COLOR)
	panel("Picture", 2.5, 1.9, out * 0.14, color)
end

-- "E" gombos interakció egy tárgyon. Alapból kikapcsolva; a Director kapcsolja be,
-- amikor a történetben sorra kerül.
local function addPrompt(part: Part, actionText: string, objectText: string): ProximityPrompt
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.ActionText = actionText
	prompt.ObjectText = objectText
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0.3
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 8
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.Enabled = false
	prompt.Parent = part
	return prompt
end

local function addLight(part: Part, range: number, brightness: number): Lamp
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Range = range
	light.Brightness = brightness
	light.Color = LAMP_COLOR
	light.Parent = part
	return { part = part, light = light }
end

-- Mennyezeti függőlámpa
local function ceilingLamp(parent: Instance, x: number, z: number): Lamp
	deco(parent, "LampCord", Vector3.new(0.15, 1.3, 0.15), Vector3.new(x, WALL_HEIGHT - 0.65, z), DARK_WOOD_COLOR)
	local shade = deco(parent, "Lamp", Vector3.new(2, 0.6, 2), Vector3.new(x, WALL_HEIGHT - 1.5, z), LAMP_COLOR, Enum.Material.Neon)
	return addLight(shade, 24, 0.45)
end

-- facing: 1 = dél felé néz (alap), -1 = észak felé
local function plushie(parent: Instance, position: Vector3, color: Color3, facing: number?): Part
	local body = box(parent, "Plushie", Vector3.new(1.5, 2, 1.5), position, color, Enum.Material.Fabric)
	local head = deco(body, "Head", Vector3.new(1.3, 1.2, 1.3), position + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0), color, Enum.Material.Fabric)
	-- fülek és szemek, hogy plüssnek látsszon, ne kockának
	for _, direction in { -1, 1 } do
		deco(head, "Ear", Vector3.new(0.4, 0.5, 0.3), position + Vector3.new(direction * 0.45, 2.3, 0), color, Enum.Material.Fabric)
		deco(head, "Eye", Vector3.new(0.18, 0.18, 0.1), position + Vector3.new(direction * 0.3, 1.6, 0.66 * (facing or 1)), Color3.fromRGB(30, 25, 30))
	end
	return body
end

MapBuilder.plushie = plushie

function MapBuilder.build(): Map
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Map"

	local structure = Instance.new("Folder")
	structure.Name = "Structure"
	structure.Parent = folder

	-- Talaj, padló, plafon
	box(structure, "Ground", Vector3.new(400, 1, 400), Vector3.new(0, -1.5, 0), Color3.fromRGB(30, 45, 35), Enum.Material.Grass)
	box(structure, "Floor", Vector3.new(80, 1, 60), Vector3.new(0, -0.5, 0), FLOOR_COLOR, Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)
	box(structure, "Ceiling", Vector3.new(80, 1, 60), Vector3.new(0, WALL_HEIGHT + 0.5, 0), CEILING_COLOR)

	-- Külső falak (a déli falon a bejárati ajtó helye kimarad)
	wall(structure, -40, -30, 40, -30)
	wall(structure, -40, -30, -40, 30)
	wall(structure, 40, -30, 40, 30)
	wall(structure, -40, 30, -4, 30)
	wall(structure, 4, 30, 40, 30)

	-- A folyosó északi fala (ajtónyílások: hálószoba, raktár, zeneszoba)
	wall(structure, -40, -5, -30, -5)
	wall(structure, -22, -5, -4, -5)
	wall(structure, 4, -5, 22, -5)
	wall(structure, 30, -5, 40, -5)

	-- A folyosó déli fala (ajtónyílások: nappali, előszoba, konyha)
	wall(structure, -40, 5, -30, 5)
	wall(structure, -22, 5, -7, 5)
	wall(structure, 7, 5, 22, 5)
	wall(structure, 30, 5, 40, 5)

	-- Szobák közti válaszfalak
	wall(structure, -12, -30, -12, -5)
	wall(structure, 12, -30, 12, -5)
	wall(structure, -12, 5, -12, 30)
	wall(structure, 12, 5, 12, 30)

	-- Ajtónyílások fölötti falrészek
	lintel(structure, -26, -5, 8)
	lintel(structure, 0, -5, 8)
	lintel(structure, 26, -5, 8)
	lintel(structure, -26, 5, 8)
	lintel(structure, 0, 5, 14)
	lintel(structure, 26, 5, 8)
	lintel(structure, 0, 30, 8)

	-- Mennyezeti lámpák: szobánként egy, a folyosón kettő.
	-- A sorrend számít: a Director a 3. (konyhai) lámpát villogtatja meg először.
	local lamps = {
		ceilingLamp(structure, 0, 17),
		ceilingLamp(structure, -26, 17),
		ceilingLamp(structure, 26, 17),
		ceilingLamp(structure, -26, -17),
		ceilingLamp(structure, 0, -17),
		ceilingLamp(structure, 26, -17),
		ceilingLamp(structure, -20, 0),
		ceilingLamp(structure, 20, 0),
	}

	-- Kezdőpont az előszobában
	local spawn = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
	spawn.Name = "Spawn"
	spawn.Anchored = true
	spawn.Neutral = true
	spawn.Size = Vector3.new(6, 1, 6)
	spawn.Position = Vector3.new(0, -0.4, 22)
	spawn.Transparency = 1
	spawn.CanCollide = false
	spawn.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	spawn.Parent = folder

	local props = Instance.new("Folder")
	props.Name = "Props"
	props.Parent = folder

	---------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Előszoba
	---------------------------------------------------------------------------

	deco(props, "WelcomeMat", Vector3.new(5, 0.1, 3), Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 27), PINK_COLOR, Enum.Material.Fabric)
	box(props, "ShoeCabinet", Vector3.new(5, 2, 1.5), Vector3.new(-8.5, 1, 28.5), WOOD_COLOR, Enum.Material.Wood)
	deco(props, "Vase", Vector3.new(0.7, 1.2, 0.7), Vector3.new(-8.5, 2.6, 28.5), MINT_COLOR)
	window(props, Vector3.new(-8, 6.5, 29.5), "z-", 3, 2.5)
	picture(props, Vector3.new(-11.5, 5.5, 14), "x+", SOFT_PINK_COLOR)
	picture(props, Vector3.new(11.5, 5.5, 14), "x-", MINT_COLOR)

	---------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Folyosó
	---------------------------------------------------------------------------

	deco(props, "RunnerRug", Vector3.new(64, 0.1, 4), Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0), PINK_COLOR, Enum.Material.Fabric)
	deco(props, "RunnerRugCenter", Vector3.new(63, 0.1, 3), Vector3.new(0, 0.07, 0), SOFT_PINK_COLOR, Enum.Material.Fabric)
	picture(props, Vector3.new(-14, 5.5, -4.5), "z+", LILAC_COLOR)
	picture(props, Vector3.new(13, 5.5, -4.5), "z+", SOFT_PINK_COLOR)
	picture(props, Vector3.new(-15, 5.5, 4.5), "z-", MINT_COLOR)
	picture(props, Vector3.new(15, 5.5, 4.5), "z-", LILAC_COLOR)

	---------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- Nappali
	---------------------------------------------------------------------------

	deco(props, "LivingRug", Vector3.new(14, 0.1, 12), Vector3.new(-26, 0.05, 18), SOFT_PINK_COLOR, Enum.Material.Fabric)

scripts.source:
--!strict
-- Kliens oldal: minden, amit a játékos a képernyőn lát.
-- Feliratok, aktuális cél, cetli, elsötétülés, záróképernyő.
-- A szervertől a "StoryEvent" csatornán kapja, hogy mit mutasson.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local storyEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("StoryEvent") :: RemoteEvent
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Config"))

-- Belső nézet: a kliensen is beállítjuk, mert a szerverről nem mindig érvényesül.
if Config.FirstPerson then
	player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
end

local FONT = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
local PINK = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 200)

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Felület felépítése
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "StoryGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.Parent = playerGui

local function label(parent: Instance, name: string, textSize: number): TextLabel
	local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	text.Name = name
	text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	text.Font = FONT
	text.TextSize = textSize
	text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	text.TextWrapped = true
	text.Text = ""
	text.Parent = parent
	return text
end

local function roundCorners(parent: Instance, radius: number)
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	corner.Parent = parent
end

-- Aktuális cél (felül középen, hogy ne takarja a chat)
local objective = label(gui, "Objective", 22)
objective.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
objective.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 16)
objective.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 34)
objective.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
objective.TextWrapped = false
objective.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 16, 22)
objective.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
objective.Visible = false
roundCorners(objective, 17)
local objectivePadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
objectivePadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 16)
objectivePadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 16)
objectivePadding.Parent = objective
objective.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5

-- Párbeszéddoboz (alul középen)
local dialogue = Instance.new("Frame")
dialogue.Name = "Dialogue"
dialogue.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
dialogue.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -40)
dialogue.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0, 110)
dialogue.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 16, 22)
dialogue.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
dialogue.Visible = false
dialogue.Parent = gui
roundCorners(dialogue, 14)
local dialogueStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
dialogueStroke.Color = PINK
dialogueStroke.Thickness = 2
dialogueStroke.Transparency = 0.3
dialogueStroke.Parent = dialogue

local speaker = label(dialogue, "Speaker", 20)
speaker.Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 10)
speaker.Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 24)
speaker.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
speaker.TextColor3 = PINK
speaker.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

local line = label(dialogue, "Line", 22)
line.Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 38)
line.Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 1, -48)
line.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
line.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

-- Cetli (középen, bezárható)
local note = Instance.new("Frame")
note.Name = "Note"
note.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
note.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
note.Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 380)
note.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 235, 210)
note.Visible = false
note.Parent = gui
roundCorners(note, 6)

local noteText = label(note, "Text", 20)
noteText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24)
noteText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 1, -90)
noteText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 40, 40)
noteText.Font = Enum.Font.IndieFlower
noteText.TextSize = 24
noteText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
noteText.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

local closeNote = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeNote.Name = "Close"
closeNote.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
closeNote.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -16)
closeNote.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 40)
closeNote.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 50, 50)
closeNote.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
closeNote.Font = FONT
closeNote.TextSize = 20
closeNote.Text = "Close [X]"
-- Belső nézetben az egér zárolva van; a Modal gomb felszabadítja, amíg a cetli látszik.
closeNote.Modal = true
closeNote.Parent = note
roundCorners(closeNote, 8)
closeNote.Activated:Connect(function()
	note.Visible = false
end)
-- Billentyűvel is bezárható (X vagy Esc helyett Backspace), kontrolleren a B gombbal.
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if not note.Visible then
		return
	end
	local key = input.KeyCode
	if key == Enum.KeyCode.X or key == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace or key == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB then
		note.Visible = false
	end
end)

-- Teljes képernyős réteg: elsötétüléshez, villanáshoz, záróképhez
-- Közelségjelző: üldözés közben vörösen lüktet a kép, ha Lumi a közelben van
local danger = Instance.new("Frame")
danger.Name = "Danger"
danger.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
danger.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 0, 25)
danger.BackgroundTransparency = 1
danger.ZIndex = 0
danger.Parent = gui

local overlay = Instance.new("Frame")
overlay.Name = "Overlay"
overlay.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
overlay.ZIndex = 10
overlay.Parent = gui

local endingTitle = label(overlay, "Title", 48)
endingTitle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
endingTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.45, 0)
endingTitle.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 60)
endingTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
endingTitle.TextTransparency = 1
endingTitle.ZIndex = 11

local endingSubtitle = label(overlay, "Subtitle", 24)
endingSubtitle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
endingSubtitle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.55, 0)
endingSubtitle.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 40)
endingSubtitle.TextColor3 = PINK
endingSubtitle.TextTransparency = 1
endingSubtitle.ZIndex = 11

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Működés
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function tween(instance: Instance, seconds: number, goal: { [string]: any })
	local animation = TweenService:Create(instance, TweenInfo.new(seconds), goal)
	animation:Play()
	return animation
end

-- Minden új sor megszakítja az előzőt: ezzel a számlálóval tudjuk, melyik az aktuális.
local dialogueToken = 0

local function showDialogue(payload: { speaker: string, text: string, duration: number })
	dialogueToken += 1
	local token = dialogueToken

	speaker.Text = payload.speaker
	line.Text = payload.text
	line.Font = if payload.speaker == "" then Enum.Font.GothamMedium else FONT
	line.TextColor3 = if payload.speaker == "" then Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210) else Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	dialogue.Visible = true

	-- Írógép-effekt: betűnként jelenik meg.
	local length = utf8.len(payload.text) or #payload.text
	line.MaxVisibleGraphemes = 0
	for shown = 1, length do
		if dialogueToken ~= token then
			return
		end
		line.MaxVisibleGraphemes = shown
		task.wait(0.025)
	end
	line.MaxVisibleGraphemes = -1

	task.wait(math.max(payload.duration - length * 0.025, 1))
	if dialogueToken == token then
		dialogue.Visible = false
	end
end

local function resetScreen()
	dialogueToken += 1
	dialogue.Visible = false
	note.Visible = false
	objective.Text = ""
	objective.Visible = false
	overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	endingTitle.TextTransparency = 1
	endingSubtitle.TextTransparency = 1
end

local effects = {}

-- Elkapott: gyors elsötétülés, majd lassan visszajön a kép.
function effects.Caught()
	overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	tween(overlay, 0.3, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 })
	task.wait(1.6)
	tween(overlay, 1.2, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
end

-- Rövid piros villanás a furcsa pillanatoknál.
-- A fejezet végi hosszú elsötétülés: közben a szerver visszarendezi a házat.
function effects.Blackout()
	overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
	tween(overlay, 1, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 })
	task.wait(4.2)
	tween(overlay, 1.5, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
end

function effects.Glitch()
	overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 0, 30)
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
	task.wait(0.08)
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	task.wait(0.06)
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 0.7
	task.wait(0.05)
	overlay.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
end

storyEvent.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind: string, payload: any)
	if kind == "Dialogue" then
		showDialogue(payload)
	elseif kind == "Objective" then
		objective.Text = payload
		objective.Visible = payload ~= ""
	elseif kind == "Note" then
		noteText.Text = payload
		note.Visible = true
	elseif kind == "Effect" then
		local effect = effects[payload]
		if effect then
			effect()
		end
	elseif kind == "Ending" then
		dialogueToken += 1
		dialogue.Visible = false
		note.Visible = false
		endingTitle.Text = payload.Title
		endingSubtitle.Text = payload.Subtitle
		overlay.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		tween(overlay, 1.5, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 })
		task.wait(1.5)
		tween(endingTitle, 1, { TextTransparency = 0 })
		task.wait(1)
		tween(endingSubtitle, 1, { TextTransparency = 0 })
	elseif kind == "Reset" then
		resetScreen()
	end
end)

-- Közelségjelző frissítése: 30 studnál kezd halványan látszani, 6 studnál a legerősebb.
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(0.1)
		local target = 1
		if workspace:GetAttribute("Hunting") then
			local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
			local lumi = map and map:FindFirstChild(Config.Companion.Name)
			local lumiRoot = lumi and lumi:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local character = player.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				local distance = (lumiRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
